face.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided 2048x768 transparent atlas of two identical white-haired chibi knight busts, with open eyes on the left and closed eyes on the right. Asset type: clean underlying face skin plate for a desktop pet, eyes will be drawn by the animation renderer. Primary request: REMOVE ALL facial features from BOTH faces: remove the eyes, eyelashes, eyelids, eyebrows, mouth, blush and all tiny reddish curves or creases on the face. Replace only these facial features with clean, smooth, pale warm peach skin matching the existing face. Both faces must be completely BLANK, with zero facial lines or marks, zero eye sockets, zero wrinkles. Preserve absolutely all WHITE HAIR and all its precise strands, gray linework, dark edges, shape, placement, shading, bangs, fringe and the skin-hair boundary exactly as the input, including the small pointed locks hanging over the face. Preserve face outline and chin position, neck, scarf, costume, proportions, framing and original 2048x768 two-cell layout exactly. Do not add new hair or move/re-size the face. The hair must stay in front of the blank skin exactly as in the input. Keep transparent alpha background, no matte, no text. This is a surgical facial-features removal, not a new design. Output aligned to the input so the head and sleeve anchor positions remain identical.
